APA Write-Up for Between-Groups ANOVA

apa_bg_anova_writeup.Rd

Generates an APA-style paragraph for a between-groups one-way ANOVA.

Usage

apa_bg_anova_writeup(
  anova_results_list,
  iv_name,
  dv_name,
  iv_labels = NULL,
  hypothesis_text = NULL,
  include_descriptives = TRUE
)

Arguments

anova_results_list

Output from bg_anova_answers().

iv_name

Character string. Display name for the IV.

dv_name

Character string. Display name for the DV.

iv_labels

Character vector or NULL. Labels for IV levels.

hypothesis_text

Character string or NULL. Custom hypothesis text.

include_descriptives

Logical. Include M and SD. Default TRUE.

Value

A character string with APA write-up.

Examples

data(superman)
result <- bg_anova_answers(superman, iv = "clark_grp", dv = "rt_critics_score")
writeup <- apa_bg_anova_writeup(result,
  iv_name = "Height Group", dv_name = "Critics Score",
  iv_labels = c("Under 6ft", "6ft+")
)
cat(writeup)
#> Those with Under 6ft displayed a Critics Score of 87 (*SD* = 1.41), whereas those with 6ft+ displayed a Critics Score of 76.83 (*SD* = 11.13). Contrary to the hypothesis, there was no significant difference in Critics Score between Under 6ft and 6ft+, *F*(1, 6) = 1.5, *p* = 0.267, *MSE* = 103.47.
